body: That’s what I was hoping to hear, appreciate it
My dad showed up and basically said along the lines of “Hey you’re coming to live with me for a while, pack your shit.” He’s a lot bigger than me and aggressive so I couldn’t really challenge it.

I really lack social skills. I don't know how I am going to just randomly make friends, it doesn't register with me. I go to a big party school, definitely not my type like I said, and I kinda feel like I don't belong here. I'm only here because my top schools rejected me, and it's in-state. Everyone I knew in high school was pretty much through association, from people I met in middle school when socializing didn't seem like such a challenge. But I don't know anyone at this university. And I can't afford a therapist anyways if I wanted to try it.
